simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַקְהֵל (H4721) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַקְהֵל (maqhêl) means an assembly First listed occurrence: Ps 26 12.

definitions.full: H4721. maqhel or maqhelah [ מַקְהֵל ] noun [masculine] assembly, for worship , plural: possibly choirs , מַקְהֵלִים Psa 26:12 , מַקְהֵלוֺת 68:27 .
